correctness.rationale: Classified all diameter maximizers using finite-dimensional ell_p/ell_2 norm comparison; computed exact local changes of variables with arclength Jacobians, integrated simplex/ell_p-ball/ellipse areas and exact circle law, and proved bounded-patch L1 density convergence. The linear corner case p=1 gains a factor two in the *pair* Jacobian. Deterministic independently evaluated exact-chord quadrature agrees with every sampled finite-threshold regime; infinity proof rests on expansions and compact localization.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The n=4 hypocycloid formula DOES cover astroid p=2/3, which is explicitly credited, not an original subclaim. The area-uniform Lamé law cannot imply boundary arclength probabilities by its result alone. The p=2+lambda*epsilon near-circle theorem has only successive limits, not arbitrary fixed p. The invariant-line chord exponent may match 2/p but a different sampling law and no coefficient transfer are given. Fixed-p p>2 Hessian integration plus full p<2 tip changes and p=1 are not covered as one theorem.

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The event is two independent boundary points having Euclidean separation near the curve diameter. Ellipse deformation at fixed quadratic exponent is not a reparameterization of the equal-axis Lamé exponent family. Neither formulation entails the present full law.
